variants.headline: Home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.body: A ship from the home world has arrived in the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: An arrival on the colonial route
variants.body: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
